output.summary: Annual flowering herb native to Eurasia. Its square stems carry leaves that shade from green below to purple above, and unlike true nettles it cannot sting. Young tops and leaves are eaten in salads, stir-fries or sauces, while flowers can be crystallized with sugar and egg white.
